messages:
sarah: Hey infra team — opened a small PR to standardize our module version policy and fix a lockfile mismatch that caused a staging drift.

sarah: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/542

sarah: TL;DR: bump modules to semver-compatible ranges, regenerate .terraform.lock.hcl with the recommended platforms, and wire k8s secret names from Helm values instead of hardcoded strings. Need quick reviews and a sanity check on the secrets mapping for the annotations.

samir: I'll take a look this afternoon. Does this require a state move or provider changes? :thinking_face:

sarah: No state move. The provider versions are pinned tighter in the modules but we're keeping provider source addresses stable. Main change is lockfile regen and replacing `k8s_secret_name` literal in chart values with `{{ .Values.service.secretName }}`.

jake: On the lockfile regen, can you show the exact command you used? Different devs have different terraform versions and platforms.

sarah: Sure — I ran:
```
TF_CLI_ARGS_init="-upgrade" terraform init -lockfile=write
terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64
```
Then committed the updated .terraform.lock.hcl.

maya: Quick Q on SOPS -> are we moving any sealed secret files? I saw a diff touching `secrets/ci/svc-connector.sops.yaml`.

sarah: We decrypt -> update values -> re-encrypt. No changes to key rotation. Just mapping field `connector_token` -> `.values.service.token`. The SOPS metadata is unchanged.

owen: For the k8s chart, ensure the helm release in staging uses the new value path. I can update staging values, but we should coordinate the deploy window. Suggest after CI green and after we run `terraform plan` in staging workspace.

samir: I'm concerned about non-deterministic diffs if devs run `terraform providers lock` with different provider plugin versions installed. Might be safer to standardize on a dockerized lock generation job in CI (reproducible). We already have a job runner image for tf 1.6.0.

sarah: Agreed — created an issue to add `tf-lock` job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/789

jake: Quick review: PR looks fine. Two small nits inline. Also tested `terraform plan` against a staging mirror (no changes except lockfile). :thumbsup:

infra-bot: ci/pr-checks — all checks passed for PR #542

sarah: Thanks. @owen can you handle the Helm staging value change and rollout? I can coordinate the terraform apply in staging after the Helm deploy to avoid secret mismatch.

owen: Yep, I'll patch staging values and hold the helm rollout for a 10–15 min window. Ping me when PR merges and CI finishes.

maya: One last gotcha — some services reference the secret by label selector instead of name (legacy). I left a comment on the PR suggesting a tiny compatibility helper in the chart that sets both name and label. Might save us a follow-up.

sarah: Good catch, added that helper. Thanks everyone. Plan to merge 12:30 UTC if no objections. :rocket:

samir: No objections from me. Please ensure you run `terraform plan -out=tfplan` in staging workspace and link the plan artifact before apply.

sarah: Will do. I'll post the plan link and the deploy window when ready.

jake: Thanks — nice concise PR.

owen: Ping me on Slack when you're about to apply so I can coordinate the helm rollback quick path if needed.

sarah: Will do. Closing loop here once done.
